name: PhysBench — Seq
protocol: PhysBench fixed 10,002-item full test set, Seq input protocol, zero-shot exact-choice accuracy. Merge inputs, reduced subsets, and tool-assisted PhysAgent results are excluded.

explanation.en: The score is exact-answer accuracy across all 10,002 PhysBench test items under the Seq input protocol.
explanation.zh: 分数是在 Seq input protocol 下，全部 10,002 道 PhysBench test item 的 exact-answer accuracy。

summary.en: PhysBench tests physical properties, relationships, scenes, and dynamics using text with image or sequential video-frame inputs.
summary.zh: PhysBench 使用文本、图像和按顺序输入的视频帧，测试物理属性、关系、场景和动态理解能力。

task_format.en: The model receives text plus images or sequentially sampled video frames and selects one of four answers on the fixed full test set.
task_format.zh: 模型会收到文本与图像或按顺序采样的视频帧，并在固定 full test set 上回答四选一问题。
